newsitem.title: USA: Trillion signs Congo copper-cobalt deal.
newsitem.headline: Trillion signs Congo copper-cobalt deal.

text.p: Trillion Resources of Canada said the government of the Democratic Republic of Congo, formerly Zaire, has ratified an exploration agreement between the company and state-owned Congo mining house Gecamines to explore a copper-cobalt region.
Trillion will explore a 2,800 square kilometer joint venture property centred on the city of Likasi.
The area is in the central portion of the Katanga copper belt and contiguous with the Tenke Fungurume deposit, Trillion said in a statement.
Under the deal Trillion will also, with Gecamines, evaluate 12 known deposits within the exploration area to decide which one could be immediately developed.
